notes.title: Version 0.5 Pre-alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Read the blog on the Sundermead website here:
https://www.sundermead.co.uk/Forum/Thread/41/1

[h3]Additions and New Features[/h3]
Added cabbage crop 
Added broccoli crop 
Added grape crop
added coal item
Added smelter - lets player smelt ores into an ingot, requires coal as fuel
Added brewing barrel
Added brewing barrel and smelter crafting recipes to Draupnir's shop
Added a mines quest line for Draupnir 
Added ability for players to sell mead and ale to Draupnir
Added achievement for completing Draupnir's mines questline
Added relationship system (affects what can be bought from vendors and what players can request via the summoning stone)
Added Skep beehive
Added Ale, Mead and Wine items
Added drunk effect after having drunk the three above items
Added ability to brew wine from grapes
Added ability to ale wine from wheat
Added ability to mead wine from honey
Added achievement for brewing ale
Added achievement for brewing wine
Added interaction icon for when a crop is ready to be harvested
Added message to display when the client is forcibly disconnected from the server
Added white, red, yellow and black tunics

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
Fixed auroras displaying all year round
Fixed bug that caused crop ticks not to be saved meaning players could leave a crop unwatered forever if they kept saving and reloading their game
Fixed non-error to do with multiple net ids on crops

[h3]Updates and other changes[/h3]
Removed ability to dig up crops to get their seeds back
Updated Draupnir to sell potato seeds
Updated mirror and steamworks .net versions
Updated LODs for log building pieces
Updated chest to drop all items inside when destroyed
Updated item drop shader
Updated tool items to feel more responsive
Updated scythe 3p position

Added armour system

notes.title: Version 0.1.8 Pre-alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions and New Features[/h3]
Added crosshair
Added ability to dig up crops using the shovel

Added fall damage
Added pickaxe

Added default clothing (customisation will come soon!)

notes.title: Version 0.1.7 Pre-alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions and New Features[/h3]
Added Axe Item (with animations)
Added animation to the watering can
Added the ability to chop down trees with the axe (yields 5 wood)
Added more tree models

Added pause menu
Added in-game options
Added new main-menu background
Added crafting system
Added fence crafting recipe

notes.title: Version 0.1.6 Pre-alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions and New Features[/h3]
Added the random spawning of forests (purely decorative as of 0.1.6)
Added an inventory (saves between sessions)
Added an item system with tooltips when in the inventory
Added equipment slots in the inventory (for helmets, gloves, hats, etc.) - Shovel may only dig above sea level
Added various items (Scythe, Shovel, Raspberry Seed, Watering Can, and more)
Added abillity to till the ground (right click using the Scythe)
Added abillity to water the ground (left click using the watering can)
Added finite water to the watering can (right click on water to fill it back up)
Added crops
Added crop growth (crops will grow overnight) - as of 0.1.6 crops will only take one night to pogress to its next state but this will change later
Added crop harvesting (left click on a fully grown crop with an item) - Raspberry bushes will only yield two Raspberry seeds as of 0.1.6 but this will change in the future
Added Ocean

[h3]Updates and Changes[/h3]
Performance improvements (terrain generation is now entirely asynchronous)
Made day-night cycle smoother for clients

[h3]Dev Stats:[/h3]
33 Commits
9 Tasks
3.5 Commits/Task

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 Pre-alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions and New Features[/h3]
Added a main menu
Added save system
Added ability to name a save
Added ability to input a custom seed when starting a new save (if left blank, the seed will be random)
Added interactables system (right-click on an object to interact with it)
Added sleeping
Added passing out (at 2 am)
Added a tent to sleep in (when a player sleeps, their respawn point is updated to where they slept)
Added a moon to the sky (with correct-ish phases)

[h3]Updates and Changes[/h3]
Updated some code to use unity's burst compiler for performance improvements (I plan to expand upon this in future)
Updated the initial spawn logic so players spawn near the coastline

notes.title: Version 0.1.4 Pre-Alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Additions and New Features[/h3]
Added a day-night cycle with basic UI
Added fog based upon the new skybox

[h3]Improvements and Optimisations[/h3]
Improved how gaps between terrain cells are hidden
Improved terrain cell collision mesh baking speed via multi-threading

[h3]Updates and Changes[/h3]
Updated skybox to be more in fitting with the game's art style
Updated noise function to include rolling hills and to make the world an island

notes.title: Version 0.1.3.2 Pre-Alpha Release Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First public build!

Synced Steam Id between clients (allowing for advanced steam behaviour in the future such as profile pictures)
Fixed client disconnect message not working
Allowed client to send chunk updates to the server to offload some work
Refactored code where chunk data is received to be more consistent
